# Washington Injury

> Brett McCandlis Brown & Conner PLLC is a Washington State personal injury law firm specializing in accident claims, wrongful death, and injury compensation across multiple practice areas.

This personal injury law firm serves clients throughout Washington State with offices in major cities including Seattle, Spokane, Bellingham, and Tacoma. They have recovered over $100M in settlements and verdicts for clients across diverse accident and injury types.
